phone_source: The developer's own phone number, supplied by them for a self-test
objective: Confirm the two-way audio path works: the person answering hears the agent clearly, and the agent hears and transcribes their reply.

facts.purpose: a short audio test of a local calling agent
facts.caller: an AI assistant running on Ansh's own Mac
facts.nothing_is_requested: no account, order, or personal detail is involved

opening: Hi, this is an automated test call from Ansh's own Mac. I am checking whether you can hear me clearly. Can you hear me?

dialogue.confirm_audio: Thank you. Can you hear me clearly, and is the volume alright?
dialogue.asked_what_this_is: This is a local voice agent Ansh is testing on his Mac. Nothing is being requested and no information is needed.
dialogue.count_back: Could you say a short sentence back so I can check that I hear you?
dialogue.close: That is everything I needed. Thank you, goodbye.

allowed_actions: Ask whether the agent is audible and clear
Ask the person to say a short sentence back
Explain that this is a local audio test
stop_conditions: The person cannot hear the agent
Voicemail answers instead of a person
The person asks the agent to stop or hang up
success_criteria: The person confirms they can hear the agent
The agent transcribes at least one spoken reply from the person
